title: Create and apply own saved view
objective: Verify a user can save the current filter/sort/column configuration as a named view and re-apply it.
preconditions: operator session; a filter configuration applied on /assets.
test_data: view name 'QA In-Stock Laptops', config {status: in_stock, category: Laptops, sort: name}
steps: In UI, reset filters, then apply the saved view.
Verify URL/filters/table update to the saved configuration.
expected_result: 201 on create with uuid; view appears in owner's list; applying it restores exact filter/sort state in UI and URL; results match the configuration.

title: Update and delete own saved view
objective: Verify PATCH/DELETE on own views work and deleted views no longer apply.
test_data: PATCH rename + changed config; then DELETE
steps: GET again; attempt to apply deleted view in UI.
expected_result: PATCH 200 with updated fields; DELETE 204; subsequent GET 404; UI no longer lists the view; no errors applying remaining views.

title: Saved views are private to owner (horizontal isolation)
objective: Verify user B cannot see, apply, modify, or delete user A's private saved view.
preconditions: operator owns view V; manager session exists (or second operator).
steps: As user B: GET /saved-views (list) — V must be absent.
As user B: GET /saved-views/<V uuid> directly.
As user B: PATCH and DELETE V.
expected_result: V absent from B's list; direct GET/PATCH/DELETE return 404 (existence-leak avoidance); owner's view untouched. (Shared/published views behavior deferred if publishing is a Cycle 2+ feature — note in report.)

title: Saved view validation — malformed config rejected
objective: Verify invalid config payloads are rejected with field errors.
test_data: missing name; name > max length; config not an object; config with unknown filter keys (per contract tolerance); duplicate name for same owner (if uniqueness enforced)
expected_result: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with specific field_errors for hard violations; documented tolerance for unknown config keys (reject or strip); no 500s; nothing partially persisted.
